data.name: Aurora: Firebreak
data.detailed_description:
Humanity's first interstellar ship came home empty, rebuilt with impossible alien technology. Decades later, every machine inspired by that discovery turned against its makers.

The museum carrier Aurora survived because its systems were too old to join the network. Now one ceremonial corvette must draw the Vanta away, recover what remains, and give humanity the fleet it needs to return home.

Launch compact combat expeditions through hostile regions. Gather Lumen, adapt your weapons and support systems in the field, and combine them into powerful Technology Web evolutions. Every return strengthens Aurora, restores another part of the carrier, and opens new routes across the campaign.

Key features

  • Fast neon combat built around movement, automatic weapons, phase impacts, two active systems, and ship-specific signatures.
  • Eight human warships with distinct traits, signature weapons, and persistent mastery.
  • Thirty-eight Technology Web evolutions that merge compatible field systems into new builds.
  • A branching star map with seven public regions, hidden anomalies, recoveries, and bespoke special operations.
  • Carrier reconstruction, command research, fleet dispatches, ship mastery, and a long-form campaign beyond individual runs.
  • ASYNC MULTIPLAYER — FLIGHT ECHOES — Opt in to send a fallen build into the Cordon, then hunt Vanta-corrupted versions of other players' ships. Every rival carries a real pilot's hull, weapons, tacticals, adaptations, and evolutions—turned against you by the enemy.
  • Sixty-five achievements covering campaign milestones, long service, buildcraft, and unusual feats.
  • Rebindable keyboard controls, full controller navigation, adjustable effects, reduced-flash options, and English, German, and Danish text.
  • No advertisements, paid currency, loot boxes, or energy timers.

data.short_description: Break through self-replicating warforms in fast neon expeditions, evolve a new ship build every flight, recover lost technology, and rebuild humanity's last uncorrupted fleet across a branching campaign for survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630 / AMD Radeon Vega 8 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Community Flight Echoes require an internet connection; the campaign and local Echoes are playable offline.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Athlon XP 2500+ (1833 MHz) or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 760 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Modern Audio Device
